en.dialogue_intro_level3: Commander, we've detected a new type of enemy. <color=#06DDEF>This enemy will attack your units</color>. Try to protect them as best as you can. Good luck!
en.dialogue_end_of_game: Well done, commander. Thanks to your efforts, Alpha Quadrant is saved.
en.system_intro2: <color=#0CCF5A>Next, put the unit on a space. To do that, we will create an <color=#06DDEF>ordered pair</color>.
en.dialogue_intro_level5_b: Also, we've detected a new enemy type. We don't have much data, except that <color=#06DDEF>it has some kind of shield to protect it from attacks to the front</color>.
en.unitButton_trackingBeam: Has large range and targets the nearest enemy.
en.dialogue_intro_level7: Commander, we've created a new unit for you. Be very careful with it!
en.unitButton_straightShooter: Attacks in a horizontal line. Enter coordinates again to change direction.
en.dialogue_enemy_incoming: Commander, the enemy is about to attack! Get ready!
en.system_activate_ability: <color=#0CCF5A>To activate a unit's special ability, re-enter the X and Y values where the unit is located.</color>
en.system_bomb_intro: <color=#0CCF5A>You can activate the unit by re-entering its coordinates. <color=#06DDEF>All units</color> in range will be defeated, but <color=#06DDEF>your base will be unaffected</color>. Use caution!</color>
en.system_intro_level1_a: <color=#0CCF5A>Every enemy portal has a visible timer to let you know when their attack starts. Build some units while the enemy is getting ready to attack.</color>
en.system_intro1: <color=#0CCF5A>In this game, you'll create units to defend your base. Start by selecting this unit with the left mouse button.</color>
en.unitButton_verticalShooter: Attacks up and down at the same time.
en.system_game_over_level1: <color=#0CCF5A>You don't have to wait for a unit to finish building before making another one! You can build up to 3 units at a time if you have enough scrap.</color>
en.system_game_over_level6: <color=#0CCF5A>Try setting up defenses on the Y axis to start. Once you have a lot of scrap, build a strong unit in the power-up space!</color>
en.dialogue_intro_level4: This is Mother Base. We've identified an unusual entity that appears to change your units in some way. It will help in our fight against the enemy.
en.disclaimer: No AI was used in the creation of this game!
en.system_power_space_intro: <color=#0CCF5A>Building a unit over this space will <color=#06DDEF>power up your unit</color>. The effects are different for each unit, but for now try building this one. Don't forget to change its direction!</color>
en.system_game_over_level4: <color=#0CCF5A>It might seem tough to fight many enemies at once. Stay calm, <color=#06DDEF>let the base take some hits</color>, and focus on other enemies.</color>
en.system_game_over_level2: <color=#0CCF5A>Using the new unit is the easiest way to win. Just one of them can defeat 2 enemies at the same time if you put it in the right spot!</color>
en.dialogue_intro_level5_a: Commander, we've created a new unit for you to try, but we're short on scrap for you to build it right away. Retire some enemies and collect more scrap.
en.system_game_over_level8: <color=#0CCF5A>Remember that the capture unit can retire all units in 1 hit. <color=#06DDEF>A powered-up capture unit will not retire your units!</color></color>
en.dialogue_intro_level8: This is it, commander. The enemy will be hitting us hardest in their final wave. We detect a new enemy type, and it seems to be very tough. Do your best!
en.dialogue_end_of_tutorial: All enemies have retreated. Good job commander, but we can't rest yet. We've detected more enemies coming our way!
en.system_game_over_level5: <color=#0CCF5A>The unit that you put in the powered space will decide how easy the enemies are. Try powering up different units to learn what they do!</color>
en.unitSelect_x:
Select X value
(Right click to cancel)
en.unitButton_bomb: Captures <color=#E1341E>all units</color> in its range. Base is unaffected. Enter coordinates again to activate.
en.system_intro4: <color=#0CCF5A>The column of numbers is called the <color=#06DDEF>Y axis.</color> Select the value on the Y axis.</color>
en.system_intro_juggernaut: <color=#0CCF5A>The enemy's new unit is so powerful, <color=#06DDEF>the base will be destroyed in 1 hit if it gets close</color>. Good luck!</color>
en.unitSelect_y:
Select Y value
(Right click to cancel)
en.system_game_over_level7: <color=#0CCF5A>Did you know that the new unit can't be damaged by enemy attacks? Try using it as a shield to protect your units!</color>
en.dialogue_intro: Commander, this is Mother Base. Sorry to wake you up early, but we're under attack! Alpha Quadrant must be defended!
en.system_intro_level1_b: <color=#0CCF5A>Mother Base has provided some <color=#06DDEF>scrap parts</color> for you to build your units. If you need more scrap, <color=#06DDEF>make enemies retreat with your units.</color> Good luck!</color>
en.system_ordered_pair_reinforcement: <color=#0CCF5A>Nice work. Remember, an ordered pair always starts with a value on the X axis, and then a value on the Y axis. These 2 values together are called <color=#06DDEF>coordinates</color>.</color>
en.system_game_over_level3: <color=#0CCF5A>Always have at least 2 units that can protect each other from enemy attacks. Be ready to build new units before your other units retreat! Grab any crystals that appear!</color>
en.dialogue_intro_level2: This is Mother Base. We've created a new unit for you. Deploy it when you're ready.
en.dialogue_intro_level5_b2: Your new unit should ignore the shield entirely, and your other units may have ways to get past the shield.
en.buildQueueFull: Can only build 3 units at a time!
en.dialogue_crystal_intro: Commander, a <color=#06DDEF>crystal</color> has appeared at the <color=#06DDEF>origin</color>. If you <color=#06DDEF>enter the origin's coordinates</color>, we can use it to build more units.
en.system_intro3: <color=#0CCF5A>The bottom row of numbers is called the <color=#06DDEF>X axis</color>. Select the value on the X axis with the left mouse button.</color>
en.dialogue_intro_level1: Commander, the enemy is here. We have figured out when they are going to attack. Use this time to prepare our defenses!
en.dialogue_origin_intro: <color=#0CCF5A>Good! The <color=#06DDEF>origin</color> is where the X and Y axes cross each other. The origin's coordinates is always (0,0).</color>
en.dialogue_build_second_unit: Good job, commander. Build one more unit to back up the first one!
en.dialogue_activate_ability: Commander, order the new unit to change its direction.
en.dialogue_intro_level6: This is Mother Base. It looks like you're up against 3 enemy types, but they won't attack at the same time. Check which enemy's going to be ready first and prepare!
